description: Vector, quaternion and matrix types at library boundaries, and the adapters that convert between them.

position_precision.description: The scalar type world positions use. A library that exposes no world positions, such as a UI library, leaves it out.

handedness.description: Coordinate convention, when the library has one.

rules.text: Every library that exposes world positions uses the composition's position_precision. With no such library in the composition the rule is not-applicable.

seeded_violation.description: Choose double position precision while a library uses float.

rules.text: The library's adapters to the math library in the composition's math slot convert a set of sample values there and back without loss.
Each adapter states the handedness and up-axis conversion it applies.
